description: List the tenant's bills of materials: finished good (id, SKU, name), the isPrimary flag planning explodes on, and the component lines in BOM order (component SKU/name/type — noninventory lines are labor/overhead — quantity per unit, UoM, optional/scrap/note). Optionally filter to one finished good by SKU. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500 per call. An unpinned 3PL operator can pass clientId to list one client's BOMs.

clientId.description: Optional client id for a 3PL operator view. Client-pinned credentials omit it.

finishedGoodSku.description: Optional finished-good SKU (case-insensitive exact match) to fetch a single item's BOM.

name: list_bills_of_materials

scrapPercentage.description: Expected scrap/waste as a percentage from 0 to 100 (5 = 5% extra material).

title: List Bills of Materials
